businessCards.title: Business Cards
businessCards.intro: Business cards are an essential part of your company’s visual identity and a practical way to introduce yourself or your brand. We offer various sizes, paper types, and finishes — matte, glossy, laminated, or rounded corners.
businessCards.text1: Primastella Printing House in Tallinn can also help with design to ensure your card reflects your brand professionally and elegantly. All cards are printed on high-quality Colotech 300 gsm white matte paper.
businessCards.text2: Orders are completed quickly and accurately — a quality business card creates a first impression that lasts.

forms.title: NCR Forms
forms.intro: Carbonless forms are a convenient and professional solution for managing documents such as orders, invoices, and work sheets. They allow you to create instant copies without the need for a copier or printer.
forms.text1: We print carbonless forms in A6, A65, A5, and A4 formats. Available as 2-, 3-, or 4-part sets, depending on your needs.
forms.text2: The first sheet is white, while the following sheets can be yellow, light pink, light blue, or light green. Sequential numbering can also be added to make document handling easier and more accurate.
forms.text3: Primastella printing house ensures high-quality printing, accurate colours, and fast production.

flyers.title: Flyers
flyers.intro: Flyers are an effective way to promote your products, services, or events.
flyers.text1: High-quality colour printing ensures that your message stands out and leaves a professional impression.
flyers.text2: We print flyers on glossy or matte coated paper with a thickness of 100–170 gsm.
flyers.text3: Available formats include A7 (74×105 mm), A6 (105×148 mm), A5 (148×210 mm), A65 (99×210 mm), and A4 (210×297 mm).

brochures.title: Brochures
brochures.intro: A brochure is a folded leaflet – a compact and effective way to present your product or service. Brochures are commonly used at fairs, events, and in marketing materials.
brochures.text1: They vary in size and number of folds. We usually print brochures on 120–190 g paper, ensuring vivid colors and a professional finish.
brochures.text2: You can choose between matte or glossy paper, depending on the desired appearance and purpose. Finishing options include folding, creasing, lamination, and varnishing.
brochures.text3: The most common types of folds are V-fold, Z-fold, and C-fold brochures.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.intro: We produce stickers using two different printing machines, depending on the desired quantity and purpose.
stickers.text1: We offer various types of paper and PVC stickers suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
stickers.text2: Paper stickers are printed on A3 sheets, while PVC stickers are made in larger formats (ideal for wide-format printing such as advertisements or product labeling).

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.intro: We offer wall calendars in various sizes and designs to suit your needs and brand style. All calendars are produced with high quality and are perfect for office use or as gifts for clients.
calendars.text2:
• One-part wall calendar
• Three-part wall calendar
• Three-part wall calendar with an additional advertising strip
• Three-in-one wall calendar
calendars.text3: Calendars can be customized with your company logo, colors, and images, creating a practical and memorable promotional product.

posters.title: Posters and Large Format Printing
posters.intro: We print posters and large-format materials for both indoor and outdoor use. You can choose from a variety of materials, finishes, and sizes – from A4 up to A0 and custom dimensions. If needed, we can assist with design to ensure the final result aligns with your brand and captures attention.
posters.text1: Common materials: 130–200 g paper, PVC vinyl (including adhesive vinyl), fabric (banner), PVC board/foam board, roll-up banner material.
posters.text2: Finishing options: matte or glossy lamination, mounting tape.
posters.text3: Applications: campaign posters, event graphics, shop window and retail graphics, exhibition stands, directional and indoor signs.
posters.text4: File preparation: CMYK color mode, resolution 150–300 dpi, bleed 3–5 mm, text converted to outlines.

envelopes.title: Envelopes
envelopes.intro: Envelopes with your company logo and contact details are an important part of professional correspondence. They help create a strong first impression that reflects your brand’s values and reliability.
envelopes.text1: We print your logo, contact information, or other details on standard white envelopes — available in C65, C5, and C4 sizes. If needed, we can also assist with design to ensure your envelopes match your company’s visual identity.
envelopes.text2: The minimum order quantity is 100 pieces.
